_strings.description: A return claims object if one exists that's unresolved

acquisition_date.description: The date the item was acquired

acquisition_source.description: Information about the acquisition source (it is not really a vendor id)

biblio_id.description: Internal identifier for the parent bibliographic record

call_number_source.description: Classification source used on this item

checked_out_date.description: Defines if item is checked out (NULL for not checked out, and checkout date for checked out)

checkouts_count.description: Number of times this item has been checked out/issued

collection_code.description: Authorized value for the collection code associated with this item

damaged_date.description: The date and time an item was last marked as damaged, NULL if not damaged

damaged_status.description: Authorized value defining this item as damaged

effective_item_type_id.description: Effective itemtype defining the type for this item_id

effective_not_for_loan_status.description: Authorized value defining why this item is not for not_for_loan_status

exclude_from_local_holds_priority.description: Exclude this item from local holds priority.

holding_library_id.description: Library that is currently in possession item

holds_count.description: Number of times this item has been placed on hold/reserved

home_library_id.description: Internal library id for the library the item belongs to

item_type_id.description: Itemtype defining the type for this item

last_checkout_date.description: The date the item was last checked out

last_seen_date.description: The date the item barcode was last scanned

location.description: Authorized value for the shelving location for this item

lost_date.description: The date and time an item was last marked as lost, NULL if not lost

lost_status.description: Authorized value defining this item as lost

not_for_loan_status.description: Authorized value defining why this item is not for loan

permanent_location.description: Linked to the CART and PROC temporary locations feature, stores the permanent shelving location

renewals_count.description: Number of times this item has been renewed

replacement_price.description: Cost the library charges to replace the item (e.g. if lost)

replacement_price_date.description: The date the replacement price is effective from

restricted_status.description: Authorized value defining use restrictions for this item

return_claims.description: An array of all return claims associated with this item

timestamp.description: Date and time this item was last altered

withdrawn.description: Authorized value defining this item as withdrawn

withdrawn_date.description: The date and time an item was last marked as withdrawn, NULL if not withdrawn
